7609-eugene-aram-volume-01.creator: Unknown
7609-eugene-aram-volume-01.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Since, dear Reader, I last addressed thee, in "Paul Clifford," nearly two years have elapsed, and somewhat more than four years since, in "Pelham," our familiarity first began. The Tale which I now submit to thee differs equally from the last as from the first of those works; for of the two evils, perhaps it is even better to disappoint thee in a new style than to weary thee with an old.

arxiv-1912-01571.title: Zeta Functions of ℤ p \mathbb{Z}_{p} -Towers of Curves
arxiv-1912-01571.creator: Daqing Wan
arxiv-1912-01571.description: Abstract . In these notes, we explore possible stable properties for the zeta function of a geometric ℤ p \mathbb{Z}_{p} -tower of curves over a finite field of characteristic p p , in the spirit of Iwasawa theory. A number of fundamental questions and conjectures are proposed for those ℤ p \mathbb{Z}_{p} towers coming from algebraic geometry. 1.

arxiv-2107-02902.title: Monitoring and Control System Development and Experimental Validation for a Novel Extrapulmonary Respiratory Support Setup Thanks: The authors are with the Departments of Mechanical Engineering and Biomedical Engineering at the University of Maryland, College Park, and the University of Maryland Sch
arxiv-2107-02902.creator: Mahsa Doosthosseini, Kevin R. Aroom, Majid Aroom, Melissa Culligan, Warren Naselsky,Chandrasekhar Thamire, Henry W. Haslach, Jr., Stephen A. Roller, James Richard Hughen, Joseph S. Friedberg, Jin-Oh Hahn, Hosam K. Fathy
arxiv-2107-02902.description: Abstract This paper presents a novel mechatronic setup intended for providing respiratory support to patients suffering from pulmonary failure. The setup relies upon the circulation of an oxygenated perfluorocarbon (PFC) through the abdominal cavity. Such circulation provides a potential pathway for the transport of oxygen to the bloodstream.

arxiv-2203-08499.title: Significance of chiral three-nucleon force contact terms for understanding of elastic nucleon-deuteron scattering
arxiv-2203-08499.creator: H. Witała, J. Golak, R. Skibiński
arxiv-2203-08499.description: Abstract We investigate the importance of the three-nucleon (3N) force contact terms in elastic nucleon-deuteron (Nd) scattering by applying the N 4 LO + chiral semi-local momentum space (SMS) regularized nucleon-nucleon (NN) chiral potential supplemented by N 2 LO and all subleading N 4 LO three-nucleon force (3NF) contact terms.

arxiv-2301-04355.title: SIR–Model for Households
arxiv-2301-04355.creator: Philipp Dönges, Thomas Götz, Nataliia Kruchinina, Tyll Krüger, Karol Niedzielewski, Viola Priesemann, Moritz Schäfer
arxiv-2301-04355.description: Abstract Households play an important role in disease dynamics. Many infections happening there due to the close contact, while mitigation measures mainly target the transmission between households. Therefore, one can see households as boosting the transmission depending on household size. To study the effect of household size and size distribution, we differentiated the within and between household reproduction rate.

arxiv-2307-09615.title: Looking deeper into interpretable deep learning in neuroimaging: a comprehensive survey
arxiv-2307-09615.creator: Md Mahfuzur Rahman, Vince Calhoun, Sergey Plis
arxiv-2307-09615.description: Abstract Abstract Deep learning (DL) models have been popular due to their ability to learn directly from the raw data in an end-to-end paradigm, alleviating the concern of a separate error-prone feature extraction phase. Recent DL-based neuroimaging studies have also witnessed a noticeable performance advancement over traditional machine learning algorithms.

arxiv-2309-04715.title: Optimal Scheduling of Variable Speed Pumps using Mixed Integer Linear Programming - Towards an Automated Approach
arxiv-2309-04715.creator: Tomasz Janus, Bogumil Ulanicki, Kegong Diao
arxiv-2309-04715.description: Abstract This article describes the methodology for formulating and solving optimal pump scheduling problems with VSP as MILP using piece-linear approximations of the network components. The WDN ( WDN ) is simulated with an initial pump schedule for a defined time horizon, e.g. 24 hours, using a nonlinear algebraic solver.

arxiv-2311-18353.title: Evaluating the Rationale Understanding of Critical Reasoning in Logical Reading Comprehension
arxiv-2311-18353.creator: Akira Kawabata, Saku Sugawara
arxiv-2311-18353.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Akira Kawabata, Saku Sugawara. To precisely evaluate a language model’s capability for logical reading comprehension, we present a dataset for testing the understanding of the rationale behind critical reasoning. For questions taken from an existing multiple-choice logical reading comprehension dataset, we crowdsource rationale texts that explain why we should select or eliminate answer options, resulting in 3,003 multiple-choice subquestions that are associated with 943 main questions.

arxiv-2312-04571.title: SwarMer: A Decentralized Localization Framework for Flying Light Specks
arxiv-2312-04571.creator: Hamed Alimohammadzadeh, Shahram Ghandeharizadeh
arxiv-2312-04571.description: Abstract . Swarm-Merging, SwarMer, is a decentralized framework to localize Flying Light Specks (FLSs) to render 2D and 3D shapes. An FLS is a miniature sized drone equipped with one or more light sources to generate different colors and textures with adjustable brightness.

arxiv-2410-19200.title: Binary Classification: Is Boosting stronger than Bagging?
arxiv-2410-19200.creator: Dimitris Bertsimas, Vasiliki Stoumpou
arxiv-2410-19200.description: Abstract Random Forests have been one of the most popular bagging methods in the past few decades, especially due to their success at handling tabular datasets. They have been extensively studied and compared to boosting models, like XGBoost, which are generally considered more performant.

arxiv-2508-02930.title: Model-agnostic Meta-learning for Adaptive Gait Phase and Terrain Geometry Estimation with Wearable Soft Sensors
arxiv-2508-02930.creator: Zenan Zhu, Wenxi Chen, Pei-Chun Kao, Janelle Clark, Lily Behnke, Rebecca Kramer-Bottiglio, Holly Yanco, Yan Gu
arxiv-2508-02930.description: Abstract This letter presents a model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) based framework for simultaneous and accurate estimation of human gait phase and terrain geometry using a small set of fabric-based wearable soft sensors, with efficient adaptation to unseen subjects and strong generalization across different subjects and terrains.

arxiv-2510-14354.title: Leveraging Cycle-Consistent Anchor Points for Self-Supervised RGB-D Registration
arxiv-2510-14354.creator: Siddharth Tourani 1 4 , Jayaram Reddy 2 , Sarvesh Thakur 2 , K Madhava Krishna 2 , Muhammad Haris Khan 4 , N Dinesh Reddy 3
arxiv-2510-14354.description: Abstract With the rise in consumer depth cameras, a wealth of unlabeled RGB-D data has become available. This prompts the question of how to utilize this data for geometric reasoning of scenes. While many RGB-D registration methods rely on geometric and feature-based similarity, we take a different approach.

arxiv-2511-04475.title: Correlated electronic structure and local spin in lead-copper-vanadium-bromine apatite: a DMFT study
arxiv-2511-04475.creator: Ihor Sukhenko, Volodymyr Karbivskyy
arxiv-2511-04475.description: Abstract We study the correlated electronic structure and local spin behaviour of the copper-substituted lead–vanadium bromine apatite Pb 9 Cu(VO 4 ) 6 Br 2 using DFT+DMFT with a two-orbital Cu-centred low-energy model. Simulations are done for several temperatures (20, 60, 100 K) and a broad range of band fillings 2.46 ≤ \leq n ≤ \leq 3.54.

arxiv-2605-26620.creator: Lukas Ellinger, Alexander Fichtl, Miriam Anschütz, Georg Groh

britannica-1911-bar-sur-aube.description: Article 'Bar-sur-Aube' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 3), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. In 1814 several actions between the French and the army of the allies took place at Bar-sur-Aube (see Napoleonic Wars Napoleonic Campaigns).

pmc-10593853.title: Plant mediated fabrication of silver nanoparticles, process optimization, and impact on tomato plant
pmc-10593853.creator: Madeeha Ansari, Shakil Ahmed, Asim Abbasi, Muhammad Tajammal Khan, Mishal Subhan, Najat A Bukhari, Ashraf Atef Hatamleh, Nader R Abdelsalam
pmc-10593853.description: Nanotechnology is one of the fastest-growing markets, but developing eco-friendly products, their maximum production, stability, and higher yield is a challenge. In this study, silver nanoparticles were synthesized using an easily available resource, leaves extract of the Neem (Azadirachta indica) plant, as a reducing and capping agent, determined their effect on germination and growth of tomato plants.

pmc-11534837.title: Temporal entry of pesticides through pollen into the bee hive and their fate in beeswax
pmc-11534837.creator: Christina Kast, Jan Müller, Marion Fracheboud
pmc-11534837.description: Honey bees are often exposed to a variety of contaminants, including pesticides from agricultural use. The aim of this study was to investigate the temporal entry of pesticides into the hive by examining the seasonal timing of honey bees bringing pesticide-contaminated pollen into their colonies and the subsequent accumulation of these pesticides in beeswax.

pmc-11564146.title: Combination of Milk Polar Lipids and Casein Hydrolysate as a Healthy Emulsifier for Ice Cream
pmc-11564146.creator: Ji-Hwa Park, Yu Bin Lee, Sung Ho Lee, Eunkyung Ko, Jee-Young Imm
pmc-11564146.description: The demand for healthy ingredients in food products including ice cream, is continuously increasing. The potential of a combination of milk polar lipids (MPL) and casein hydrolysate (CH) to replace synthetic emulsifiers such as diacetyl tartaric acid esters of monoglycerides (DATEM), in ice cream production was investigated.

pmc-11617893.title: Compound Bacillus improves eggshell quality and egg metabolites of hens by promoting the metabolism balance of calcium and phosphorus and uterine cell proliferation
pmc-11617893.creator: Qian Jin, Fei Wang, Weisheng Ye, Qi Wang, Shujie Xu, Shaoxiong Jiang, Xiang Li, Min Yue, Dongyou Yu, Mingliang Jin, Aikun Fu, Weifen Li
pmc-11617893.description: Probiotics have beneficial effects on improving egg quality, but there is little research about the effect of probiotics on metabolite composition, and the mechanisms are not yet fully understood. The aim of this study was to investigate the potential mechanisms by which compound Bacillus improves egg quality and metabolite composition. A total of 20,000 Jingfen No.

pmc-11674465.title: Cellular Immunology of Myocarditis: Lights and Shades—A Literature Review
pmc-11674465.creator: Cristina Vicenzetto, Andrea Silvio Giordani, Caterina Menghi, Anna Baritussio, Federico Scognamiglio, Elena Pontara, Elisa Bison, Maria Grazia Peloso-Cattini, Renzo Marcolongo, Alida Linda Patrizia Caforio, Antonio Rodríguez-Sinovas
pmc-11674465.description: Myocarditis is an inflammatory disease of the myocardium with heterogeneous etiology, clinical presentation, and prognosis; when it is associated with myocardial dysfunction, this identifies the entity of inflammatory cardiomyopathy. In the last few decades, the relevance of the immune system in myocarditis onset and progression has become evident, thus having crucial clinical relevance in terms of treatment and prognostic stratification.

pmc-11692331.title: NARRATIVES OF WARTIME VOLUNTEERING AMONG OLDER ADULTS IN ISRAEL
pmc-11692331.creator: Peter Sun, Liat Ayalon
pmc-11692331.description: Volunteering is an important vehicle for the health promotion of older adults, yet research on its role during times of war remain limited. This research aimed to explore the representation and rhetoric of older adult volunteers in the Israeli media during Operation Swords of Iron.

pmc-11830492.title: Diphenoxylate Toxicity in a Young Child with Acute Gastroenteritis: A Clinical Case Report
pmc-11830492.creator: Muhammad Romail Manan, Iqra Nawaz, Ahmad Zulaid, Muhammad Usama Afzal, Muhammad Atif, Muhammad Huzaifa, Anosha Fayyaz
pmc-11830492.description: Lomotil (diphenoxylate-atropine) toxicity in the pediatric population remains a significant concern particularly in low and lower middle-income countries. This may result from accidental ingestion or inappropriate therapeutic administration which can lead to life threatening complications including respiratory and central nervous system depression. A 2-year-old child presented to the pediatric emergency room in an altered state of consciousness.

pmc-12429242.title: Uric Acid to Platelet Ratio (UAPR) and Its Link to Lipid Abnormalities: Findings from a Large Cohort Study in Saudi Arabia
pmc-12429242.creator: Yazeed Alshuweishi, Lama Izziddeen, Muath Alsaidan, Noha A. Alshuwayer, Faisal A. Alshuweishi, Ahmed M. Basudan
pmc-12429242.description: Background: Lipid disturbance is a hallmark of cardiometabolic abnormalities and a primary contributor to cardiovascular disease risk. Immunometabolic markers show promise for better risk classification. This study evaluated the uric acid to Platelet ratio (UAPR) as lipid abnormality marker in a broad cohort of Saudi adults. Methods: Data from 7781 adults in the Elta Medical Laboratory database were analysed.

pmc-12580312.title: Antibiotic stewardship: what for?
pmc-12580312.creator: Carlos F. Amábile-Cuevas
pmc-12580312.description: Antibiotic stewardship programs and controlled antibiotic usage have long been considered fundamental strategies in healthcare systems, and these approaches were traditionally viewed as the primary defense against bacterial resistance development. But recent studies reveal a surprising disconnect between antibiotic usage and resistance patterns, with socioeconomic factors showing stronger correlations than clinical drug use.

pmc-12653274.title: Effectiveness of Controlled Ovarian Stimulation for Oocyte Preservation in Oncologic Patients: Insights from DuoStim Protocol
pmc-12653274.creator: Andrea Panattoni, Maria Magdalena Montt Guevara, Ilaria Marzi, Koray Görkem Saçıntı, Francesca Papini, Chiara Maggiorano, Sara Macaluso, Elena Casarosa, Tommaso Simoncini, Paolo Giovanni Artini, Vito Cela
pmc-12653274.description: Background/Objectives: Fertility preservation is a key component of oncological care. This study evaluated the effectiveness of different controlled ovarian stimulation (COS) protocols, including dual stimulation (DuoStim), for oocyte preservation, with a specific focus on breast cancer patients, and aimed to identify predictors of mature oocyte yield.

pmc-13198194.title: LC‐Pred: A Transformer‐Based Interactive Interface for Liver Cirrhosis Prediction
pmc-13198194.creator: Bisweswari Rath, Satya Ranjan Dash, Rajani Kanta Mahapatra, Dirk Uhlmann
pmc-13198194.description: ObjectivesIncorporating transformer, an innovative deep learning–based model with an authenticated and user‐friendly client‐server web application namely LC‐Pred, this study highlights the early prediction of liver cirrhosis (LC), which will be beneficial for both the clinicians and the LC patients. LC‐Pred delivers both single and bulk prediction abilities making it fast, sturdy, and secure to be used in healthcare sectors.

uslaw-usc-t16-s6102.title: 16 U.S.C. § 6102 — Purposes
uslaw-usc-t16-s6102.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s6102.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 80 (Neotropical Migratory Bird Conservation). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The purposes of this chapter are— (1) to perpetuate healthy populations of neotropical migratory birds; (2) to assist in the conservation of neotropical migratory birds by supporting conservation initiatives in the United States, Canada, Latin America, and the Caribbean; and (3) to provide financial resources.

uslaw-usc-t47-s1512.title: 47 U.S.C. § 1512 — Relationship to Middle Class Tax Relief and Job Creation Act of 2012
uslaw-usc-t47-s1512.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t47-s1512.description: United States Code, Title 47 (Telecommunications); Chapter 14 (Making Opportunities For Broadband Investment And Limiting Excessive And Needless Obstacles To Wireless). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. Nothing in this chapter shall be construed to limit, restrict, or circumvent in any way the implementation of the nationwide public safety broadband network defined in section 6001 of title VI of the Middle Class Tax.
